subject: general
question: Who was the first Indian astronaut to travel into space?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakesh Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Wing Commander **Rakesh Sharma** became the **first Indian citizen** to travel into space on **April 3, 1984**.
 
• He was a former **Indian Air Force** pilot who flew aboard the **Soviet** spacecraft **Soyuz T-11** as part of the **Intercosmos** program.
 
• The mission was a joint venture between the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** and the **Soviet Space Program**.
 
• During the mission, he spent **7 days, 21 hours, and 40 minutes** aboard the **Salyut 7** orbital station, conducting various scientific experiments, including **multi-spectral photography** of northern India.
 
• When asked by the then Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi** about how India looked from space, he famously responded, "**Sare Jahan Se Achha**" (Better than the whole world). ***Hence, the correct answer is Rakesh Sharma.***
